name: Tanvir Hasan
title: Super fast simulated delivery & great backpack!
comment: Ordered the Fjallraven backpack using my demo balance and SMART10 discount code. The UI is exceptionally responsive and smooth. Love how seamless the checkout was!

name: Nusrat Jahan
title: Stunning jewelry collection and clear BDT pricing
comment: The Petite Micropave ring simulation looks fantastic. Having prices clearly converted into simulated BDT makes it feel just like a real Bangladeshi e-commerce platform.

name: Rafiqul Islam
title: High quality SSD drive, tested live in cart
comment: Tested the cart balance limit when adding the SanDisk 1TB SSD. The system prevented checkout when my balance was low, and after clicking Add Money it processed smoothly!

name: Sadia Akhter
title: Clean Tailwind CSS styling and intuitive navigation
comment: The promotional carousel and product filters make finding winter jackets effortless. The coupon code SMART10 gave an exact 10% subtotal discount right before checkout.

name: Mahmudur Rahman
title: Impressive Vanilla JS DOM architecture!
comment: No React or Bootstrap used, purely vanilla JavaScript and Tailwind utilities. The localStorage persistence works flawlessly even when reopening or refreshing the browser.

name: Farhana Yeasmin
title: Outstanding responsive layout on mobile and desktop
comment: The sticky navigation, sliding cart drawer, and interactive carousel controls work flawlessly across screen sizes. Excellent execution of a modern single-page store.
product: Lock and Love Women's Biker Jacket
